agents-hard-constraints: - Never change the model ID in `lib/ai/models.ts` without explicit user approval.
agents-security-constraints: - Model calls go through `lib/ai/client.ts` only: named fields, a timeout, and mapped errors. Never pass a client request body to a model call.
integrations-notes: - Anthropic API (`lib/ai/client.ts`): server-side calls only; key in `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

rules.change: Model call, model config, or prompt handling changed
